subject: English
passage: Bob Dylan intended his 1965 decision to perform with electric instruments to challenge folk music purists' expectations about authentic musical expression. ______ Dylan's electric performance at the Newport Folk Festival did just that, sparking outrage among traditionalists who believed that amplified instruments betrayed the essence of folk music.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation: Choice D is the best answer. "Indeed" logically signals that the information in this sentence—that the performance sparked outrage among traditionalists who believed amplified instruments betrayed folk music's essence—offers emphasis in support of the claim in the previous sentence that the performance was intended to challenge folk purists' expectations.
